label: Whatever begins or ceases to live is MUTABLE_2: another being has power over it
paraphrase: MUTABLE_2, OPEN analyst premise (attribution deferred): whatever begins or ceases to live, between an earlier and a later time of the duration frame, is mutable through another: some other being has the power to change it in some respect (navigation: ST I q.9 a.2, creatures depend on the creator giving esse). It says nothing about potency in the thing itself.
